tools.description: Change an underground site or a building's interior from a text plan: read it with get_site_design (format: true gives the full format: item kinds, door flags, rules), change it, send it back. Only what the text gives changes: a level block with just 'items:' changes only that level; '+items:' and '-items:' add to or take from a list. Levels number from 1 at the top. Per level: 'level <n>: <name>'; 'rooms: a=<kind>[+5 raised ft][ (round|octagon|apse n|chamfered|cavern)][ "name"]; b=...'; 'grid:' one row per line, a letter per 5-ft square, '.' rock; 'doors: x,y e|s [secret|locked 1-31|portcullis|arch]; ...' ('auto' adds doors where a room is shut off); 'items: <kind> x,y [wxh] [back n|e|s|w] [variant n]; ...' (the ways exit, down, up too). Headers: a site's 'site · <n> levels' adds levels below; a building's 'building · <w> x <h> squares · <n> levels · stairs x,y wxh · cellars <n>' with levels 'level -1: Cellar', 'level 0: Ground floor' (storeys above follow the building: update_building). Refused (first reasons, a count) when it breaks a rule play needs (a site: one way in at the entry, every way down above a way up, every square reachable; a building: one front door, stairs on every level, every room reached).

fit_shapes.description: Fit shaped rooms to their shape; one that would break a rule stays square (the reply's fit_shapes says which)
